# heinzel-zoom

Read meetings from Zoom's meeting-summary emails: the meetings capability.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | **connector** |
| Version | `0.7.17` (first-party, released with Heinzelmännchen) |
| Source | <https://github.com/helmut-hoffer-von-ankershoffen/heinzel/tree/main/plugins/heinzel-zoom> |
| Licence | MIT |
| Install | `hz system plugin add zoom --confirm` |
| Modules | `zoom` |

- Connector: brings adapters for capabilities such as the tracker or the calendar (ADR 0028).

## Operations

Each column follows the kernel's actual exposure rules. MCP over stdio runs as its caller; HTTP MCP and public REST exclude private operations. Private API and web endpoints require their scoped bearer or paired session. Authentication does not grant human approval. Every CLI command takes `--json`.

### `hz zoom info`

Show this plugin's version, the Heinzelmännchen it runs on and where its meetings come from.

```bash
hz zoom info
```

## Settings

In your configuration file (`hz system config set <key> <value>`), or as environment variables.

### `[zoom]`

| Key | Type | Default | Environment variable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | `"from:zoom.us"` | `HZ_ZOOM__QUERY` | The mail search that finds Zoom's meeting-summary emails, in your mail's search syntax; mails that aren't summaries are skipped. Never read from a project's settings. (user scope only) |

## Capabilities served

| Adapter | Capability | Modes | Sends data to | Bind it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `zoom` | `meetings` | read | — | `hz system config set capabilities.meetings zoom` |

Reads: `mail:read`.

## Setup and health

- Health: `zoom` reports to `hz system doctor`.
- Info: `zoom` adds a section to `hz system info`.
